Subject: Post-demo: HelixGuard identity evidence & initial questionnaire

Hi Maya / Liam — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side after the demo:

- Goal: validate identity & access posture so we can finalize scope for Dedicated onboarding.
- Primary asks: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, and identity evidence (SSO metadata, SCIM capability, RBAC matrix, admin controls).

Action items I want to confirm with you: 
1) Can you share your current SOC 2 status (Type I/II, date of last report or expected completion)?
2) Please attach SAML metadata or the IdP config and confirm whether SCIM provisioning endpoints exist and if they require client credentials.
3) We usually ask for a simple RBAC matrix (role names -> permissions) and a note on how admin separation and emergency access are handled.

If you prefer, we've prepared a short vendor security questionnaire to speed things up — happy to take the answers in-line or via the attached workbook.

Attaching: [Attachment: redwood_sample_id_evidence_checklist.pdf (stub, 18 KB)]

Proposed timeline: if we can get these artifacts by EOD next Tue (2027-06-15), our security team can review and we can move to a short deep-dive call the following week.

I'll loop in Marissa for the RBAC/admin templates and Sean for scheduling the security deep-dive.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Hi Aditya — great demo yesterday, thanks.

A few quick answers and attachments below:

- SOC 2: In progress. We completed Type I in Jan 2027 and expect Type II by end of Q3 (target: 2027-09-30). We can share the Type I report under an NDA; Type II interim audit results will be available after our August controls run.
- GDPR/HIPAA: HelixGuard considers customer data healthcare-adjacent; we support contractual HIPAA BAA and have a GDPR data processing addendum.
- SSO/SCIM/RBAC: attaching primary artifacts now.

Attachments: 
[Attachment: HelixGuard_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 96 KB)]
[Attachment: helixguard_sso_metadata.xml (text/xml, 4 KB)]
[Attachment: helixguard_rbac_matrix.csv (text/csv, 12 KB)]

Notes on SCIM: we expose SCIM v2 endpoints; provisioning requires a service account token (OAuth2 client credentials). We can provide a short-lived client for sandbox testing.

Happy to hop on the security deep-dive once your team has had a chance to review.

Best,
Maya Patel
